title: Catalog quote fields disappear during checkout
summary: Checkout retries catalog lookups and some line items lose their displayed price, although the catalog endpoint continues returning successful responses.
precursor: The catalog provider began a staged response-format rollout after its mobile release, while checkout replicas were still running two client revisions.
impact: Affected carts cannot produce reliable totals, increasing abandoned checkouts and support contacts about missing prices.

title: Shipment route creation rejects the new endpoint
summary: New shipment plans fail consistently in one region, while previously computed delivery quotes remain available to operators.
precursor: The fulfillment platform moved its generated clients to the next API release during a region-by-region deployment.
impact: Warehouse dispatchers must defer route assignment and parcels miss their planned carrier handoff windows.

title: Ledger export calls exceed reconciliation deadlines
summary: Reconciliation jobs spend most of their runtime waiting for export responses, and ledger updates arrive progressively later.
precursor: The reporting provider enabled its next-generation export path for the billing tenant shortly before the monthly reconciliation window.
impact: Finance dashboards show stale balances and close-of-month checks cannot complete within the scheduled processing window.

title: Account linking fails around partner token renewal
summary: Partner account-linking callbacks fail in short bursts near renewal intervals, with retries temporarily increasing sign-in latency.
precursor: The identity provider rolled out a new issuer policy and shortened access-token validity while integration workers remained on a gradual restart schedule.
impact: Some users cannot link external accounts on the first attempt, and repeated callbacks delay profile synchronization.

title: Partner inventory sync throttles despite healthy connectivity
summary: Inventory refreshes complete more slowly across several tenants, and retry volume rises even though partner requests still reach the service.
precursor: The partner migrated integrations to its current API tier and published revised traffic guidance during a connector rollout.
impact: Storefront availability counts lag behind warehouse changes, causing oversell risk for fast-moving products.
